legs: Single continuous cinematic drone flight, no cuts. Over Lake Chapala at dawn the camera glides low across the misty water toward the far hillside and rises; the morning mist thickens and fills the whole frame with soft glowing gold fog.

Single continuous camera move, no cuts. The camera drifts forward through the glowing fog; the mist thins and parts to reveal a man in a straw hat and navy shirt at a rustic wooden table under a simple thatch shade on the hillside, the lake behind him; he looks up with a warm smile and rolls out the plans.

Single continuous camera move, no cuts. The man smooths the plans flat and the camera pushes in slowly over the table until the paper fills the frame, and the outline of one home on the plan begins to glow a warm mystical gold.

Single continuous magical match cut, no cuts. The glowing gold lines of the house on the paper stay in the same place while the paper dissolves into real red earth: the gold lines become taut white string lines and wooden stakes on the ground, same shape, same spot, in warm morning light.

Single continuous camera move, no cuts. The camera rises slowly from the stakes and drifts back across the building site: a small excavator digs the square cistern pit, a worker pushes a wheelbarrow of red earth along the planks, morning light.

Single continuous camera move, no cuts. The camera glides along the site as the light warms toward afternoon, arriving at the lane where workers tamp a rammed earth wall in wooden forms and masons in straw hats lay a curved brick vault behind it, dust in the light.

Single continuous camera move, no cuts, time passing in place: the camera holds steady and slowly pushes in while the wooden forms and scaffold fall away, the workers leave, and the same wall becomes the finished smooth earth street wall with a tall wooden door, the oak tree and the garden behind it, light settling to soft afternoon.
